cls: OPRT inhibitor (component of S-1, gut protection)
pharm: OPRT inhibitor (component of S-1, gut protection)
summary: Oteracil potassium concentrates in the gut and inhibits orotate phosphoribosyltransferase, reducing 5-FU activation in the gut wall and so diarrhoea and mucositis. It is only given in S-1; see Tegafur.
indications: Only as a component of S-1
admin: Use only as the finished product directs
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
